caption: 🎓 Lesson of the day: Why a stop loss matters. A stop loss is the price where you accept that your idea was wrong and close the trade. Without it, one bad trade can wipe out many good ones. Example only: if you risk a small, fixed part of your account on each trade, a loss stays small and you can keep trading. Decide the stop before you enter, never move it further away, and never trade without one. Educational content, not financial advice. Trading is high risk.
